title.zh: 国家会破产吗：国债、赤字与代际账单
title.en: Can a Country Go Bankrupt? Public Debt, Deficits, and Sovereign Arithmetic

desc.zh: 从流量与存量、基本赤字、r − g 雪球方程、本币债与外币「原罪」、到期再融资悬崖、财政乘数、养老隐性账单、历史化债拆解，到 2026 年底主要经济体账本。
desc.en: From flows vs. stocks, primary balances, and r − g snowball arithmetic to own- vs. foreign-currency debt, rollover cliffs, fiscal multipliers, PAYG pensions, historical deleveraging, and late-2026 data.

title.zh: 基本财政余额与赤字 vs 国债存量
title.en: Primary balance vs. headline deficit and debt stock

desc.zh: 剥除历史债务利息后的当期收支余额，以及为什么必须用占 GDP 比重而非名义金额衡量债务。
desc.en: Stripping legacy interest out of the annual deficit to separate flow shortfalls from cumulative debt stock.

title.zh: 债务比动态方程与 r − g 雪球边界
title.en: Debt-ratio law of motion and the r − g snowball boundary

desc.zh: 用 d_{t+1} = d_t(1+r)/(1+g) − pb 推导稳债临界基本盈余 pb*，区分温和收敛与指数滚雪球。
desc.en: Deriving the debt-stabilizing primary balance pb* from r − g and mapping converging vs. snowballing debt paths.

title.zh: 本币债与外币债（「金融原罪」与突然停摆）

desc.zh: 浮动本币发行国面临通胀与汇率约束，而高外币债国家在贬值冲击下面临资产负债表跳升与突然停摆。
desc.en: Why floating own-currency sovereigns face inflation constraints while foreign-currency borrowers face sudden stops.

title.zh: 到期期限墙、WAM 再融资与央行合并久期
title.en: Maturity walls, WAM rollover, and central-bank balance sheets

desc.zh: 加权平均期限决定加息传导速度；把财政部与央行并表后，QE 实质上把长期固息债换成了隔夜浮息准备金。
desc.en: How WAM paces coupon repricing and how central bank QE swaps fixed long bonds into floating overnight reserves.

title.zh: 财政乘数、零利率下限与利率挤出效应
title.en: Fiscal multipliers, the zero lower bound, and crowding out

desc.zh: 结合 Ramey (2019) 经验范围，计算常态 vs 零利率下限的乘数差异与 1 年 / 5 年净债务比变化。
desc.en: Calibrating normal vs. ZLB multipliers (Ramey 2019) and net 1-year vs. 5-year debt-ratio impacts.

zh: 政府刺激能自己赚回来吗

title.zh: 老龄化、现收现付养老医疗与隐性财政账单
title.en: Demographics, PAYG pensions, and off-balance-sheet liabilities

desc.zh: 抚养比下降如何通过法定养老与医疗支出挤压税收空间里的可支配预算。
desc.en: How falling worker-to-retiree ratios compress discretionary budgets beneath realistic tax ceilings.

title.zh: 历史化债分解：基本盈余、增长、通胀抑制与重组

desc.zh: 基于 Hall & Sargent 与 Acalin & Ball (2024) 重构战后美国（106%→23%）与 1990 年代整顿及重组路径。
desc.en: Decomposing post-WWII US (106% to 23%), 1990s consolidations, and restructuring episodes.

title.zh: 2026 年底主要经济体国债账本与 Blanchard–Rogoff 争论
title.en: Late-2026 sovereign debt ledger and Blanchard–Rogoff debate

desc.zh: 对比 2026 年美、日、欧、中、新兴市场的 IMF/CBO 债务与利息口径，分离会计事实、历史统计与前沿争论。
desc.en: Comparing 2026 IMF and CBO debt and interest figures across US, Japan, Euro Area, China, and EMs.
